what: Move the bench page's driver from src/player into its own bun workspace package harness/ that cannot resolve an import of the engine or the server and reads verbs, speech kinds, pending states, the snapshot and the history over the bench's routes (a new /api/subkinds serving the registry's subkinds with their families), with a thin strata adapter (src/adapter: the bench host, the route-body contract typecheck, one-call command lines), and make a headed run hold before each action until the operator presses Enter.
why: The harness was designed as a page client but nine import lines weld it to the engine and the stake against that was prose no review tested, and the C5 operator walk failed because a headed run cannot be watched. Design: docs/work/harness-package/design.md

criteria.then: an import of the engine or the server from any harness file fails the test, naming the file or the import: as it stands the typecheck and the tests exit 0 in the copy and every file the program lists lies, by real path, under the copy or under the linked node_modules' real path; and no file under src/player remains

outOfScope.summary: The harness's tests that drive a real bench live strata-side, since a real bench is strata's; the package's own tests prove its logic over fixtures and stand-ins, and the end-to-end claims are proved where the bench is.

The harness's declared route bodies are cast, not parsed, as today; a body the bench serves wrongly at run time surfaces as a wrong decision or a thrown read, and drift is caught at strata's typecheck, not at run time.

frequency.command: for f in corpus/runs/*/run.json; do jq -e '(.benchFailures // []) | length > 0' $f; done

outOfScope.summary: Jev and the model are not deterministic, so the re-scored calibration and blind-2 counts can differ with no code change; a differing count halts for a ruling rather than passing or being re-run until it matches.

frequency.reason: It bites only in this job's two re-scores, where a differing count halts for a ruling; no usage path re-scores a set to compare it.

outOfScope.summary: A headed run cannot be left unattended: it waits on Enter before every action, and a headed score run waits before every action of every goal.

frequency.command: for f in corpus/runs/*/run.json; do jq -e '.parameters.headed == true' $f; done

outOfScope.summary: The projection of a snapshot to its item holders and person locations is computed by the engine for pending afters and by the harness over the served body; the contract typecheck holds their shapes together, not their code.

frequency.reason: A structure of the code, two projections of one served shape held together by the contract typecheck; no run or usage exercises it as a case.

outOfScope.summary: Calibration is scored twice in the job, a baseline on the unmoved code and again after the move, so the job pays two calibration runs to the real endpoints.

frequency.reason: A one-time cost of this job's proof, two calibration runs of nine goals each to the real endpoints, never paid by a later run.

stakes: No file of the harness package names a path outside it; copied alone beside only its installed dependencies, it type-checks and its tests pass, so an import of the engine or the server cannot resolve.

Every fact the harness uses about verbs, their fields, speech kinds, pending states, the snapshot and the history is read from a bench route during the run; the harness holds no copy of an engine table.
The bench serves the subkinds with their families from the registry and kindOf, their one home; nothing states a subkind or a family a second time.

strata's adapter is the bench host and a typecheck that the bodies the bench serves satisfy what the harness declares for each route it reads, and its command lines are one call each into the harness.
A headed run prints each loop whole and then performs nothing until the operator presses Enter; a headless run never waits on the operator; there is no timing number.

The rule, the typed plan, pending resolution, reached by the code check, T_DONE and T_ACT, and every corpus file's fields are unchanged; calibration holds the held count and best pair of a baseline scored on the unmoved code, and blind-2 the count its committed score file records.
Every dependency version the root and the harness share has one home, the workspace catalog.
The fuzzer under src/driver is unchanged.
